mechanism: Open on one stable social group of clearly adult original characters in a readable room and identify one focal adult through at least three persistent visual anchors. Introduce one localized facial anomaly without changing identity, then escalate exactly once into a traceable displacement of the group, camera or room state. Hold the same environment briefly without the focal adult so the audience reads aftermath and anticipates a return. Reintroduce the same altered adult from an established depth axis and let proximity, not extra effects, drive the final escalation until the face occupies the frame. The reusable mechanism is ordinary group baseline, identity-preserving facial anomaly, one spatial rupture, empty-space consequence gap and same-identity direct approach—not the source people, faces, couch, room, black eyes, hair, exact expressions, motion, creator identity or timing.

invariants.rule: Establish a calm adult group, one focal identity and stable room geometry before any anomaly.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting in chaos removes the escalation contrast.

invariants.rule: Change one localized feature while preserving at least three identity anchors.
invariants.purpose: Makes the anomaly belong to the same person.
invariants.ablation_failure: A redesigned face reads as a new subject or continuity error.

invariants.rule: Use one spatially traceable group or camera displacement as the major rupture.
invariants.purpose: Converts private unease into physical consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated random shakes become noise rather than progression.

invariants.rule: Hold the established environment briefly while withholding the focal adult.
invariants.purpose: Creates aftermath evidence and a directional question.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate reappearance gives no consequence gap.

invariants.rule: Return the same altered adult from depth and end on increasing proximity rather than a new effect.
invariants.purpose: Turns preserved identity into the final threat.
invariants.ablation_failure: A different attacker or unrelated jump cut breaks the causal chain.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source adult group, woman, faces, hair, clothing, couch and exact expressions
the source domestic room, furniture, walls, floor, openings and exact staging
the source solid black eyes, possession appearance and hair transformation
the source camera displacement, group motion, low angles, approach and terminal close-up
the source creator identity, Seedance 2.5 wording and 20-second timing
